page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor operating at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It includes 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, paired with 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Hardware acceleration flags include AVX, AVX-512 (Foundation, VNNI, and BF16), as well as AES, VAES, and SHA cryptographic extensions. It contains no dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-core computational execution, with Geekbench single-core reaching 1940.0 and stress-ng single-core achieving 3080.18, both placing in the top quartile. Geekbench text processing also scores strongly at 2495.0. However, multi-core and memory throughput benchmarks demonstrate lower comparative standing due to the 4 vCPU allocation. Geekbench multi-core scores at 4345.0, and stress-ng multi-core reaches 6152.26. Potentially uncached memory bandwidth registers at 37.16 GB/sec for read and 27.94 GB/sec for write operations, while small-block cached read throughput sits at 303.4 GB/sec.

Application-level measurements indicate balanced medium performance for general utility, including static web serving throughput of 6.59 GB/sec, single-threaded gzip compression at 29.39 GB/sec, and PassMark CPU encryption at 4806.63. Workloads demanding high multi-threaded concurrency or intensive database transactions exhibit constraints, with Redis SET operations recording 5.91 million operations/sec and PassMark database operations scoring 2048.02. Small language model inference (135M) achieves 486.31 tokens/sec for prompt processing, whereas medium language model tests (7B) show constrained throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E4ads_v6 bundles fast local NVMe storage alongside an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU density without demanding higher-tier core counts. It is technically appropriate for in-memory caching systems, intermediate memory-heavy data pipelines, web application runtimes needing generous heap space, and development environments that prioritize single-threaded responsiveness and memory headroom over heavy parallel computation.
description: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized instance featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz. Configured with 32.0 GB of RAM (an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio) and 236 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, it includes modern instruction support including AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators, operating without discrete GPUs. In synthetic testing, the instance exhibits top-tier single-core CPU throughput and strong text processing, contrasted by middle-to-lower quartile metrics in multi-threaded computation, database operations, and memory bandwidth due to core limits. Static web serving reaches 6.59 GB/sec, and lightweight LLM inference runs comfortably. Given its high RAM capacity and local NVMe storage, the E4ads_v6 serves as a balanced platform for in-memory caches, web application hosting, and moderate data-processing pipelines requiring high memory per thread.
